title: 第7章 路的方向第8章 确定方向
lines: 事情不是白羽想的那样。
师父不是被断刀门老掌门打死的，反倒是他把别人打死了。
只不过二人切磋的次数多了，受了一身伤，最后虽然师父打死他了，但自己也活不久，于前年冬日走了。
人家也没有使阴谋，就是正大光明来挑战。
断刀门掌门一把年纪了，当年输给白羽以后就很不甘心，于是让出掌门之位以后就前来帮仇。
白羽寻仙去了，他最后将目光盯上老头子。
二人实力相当，打起来没完没了。
这一打就是好几年，都受不少内伤。
最后一次单挑，二人都苦练了一式绝招，最后是师父略胜一筹，然后便失手打死断刀门老掌门。
其实这么久以来二人已经成了朋友，这下失手打死朋友，师父顿时羞愧难当。
他们只是想决胜负，并不是想打死对方。
这下好了，师父本来也受了伤，再加上心情的原因，没撑几年就撒手人寰。
站在坟前，白羽心中有种说不上来的感觉。
这一世第一次经历生离死别。
他知道，这只是个开始罢了，将来还会有更多。
“两个老家伙，一把年纪学年轻人玩什么单挑……”
白羽站在坟前嘀咕。
师妹回去了一趟，然后又拿来纸钱与香烛。
叹息一声，白羽跪下了，开始祭拜老头子。
他对白羽有恩，养育之恩，教育之恩。
跪他是应该的。
祭拜完毕，白羽随着师妹回去了。
师兄回归，师妹很高兴，于是做了一大桌子菜。
吃饭时，霜儿一直盯着白羽看。
一对视，她装做没在看，一会儿又偷看。
小孩子好奇嘛，白羽微微一笑也不揭穿她。
吃过晚饭以后，天黑了下来，白羽跟师妹坐在院中凉亭闲聊。
主要还是她问，他答。
得知白羽已经奋斗二十年也没有结果。
她没有安慰，心里反倒是很高兴。
吃着橘子，她目露期待的问道：“师兄，那以后你就不走了吧？
你以前不是说要给门派打响名号嘛，不如这样，咱们多招点弟子，干脆扩大门派规模，做大做强。”
闻言，白羽有些晃神，这些话都是他以前说过的。
“做大做强。”
低声重复，白羽双眼很迷茫。
content_en:
Things were not what Bai Yu thought.
The master was not beaten to death by the old leader of the Broken Blade Clan, but he beat others to death.
It's just that the two of them sparred too many times and suffered injuries. In the end, although the master beat him to death, he didn't live long and left in the winter of the year before last.
They didn't use any conspiracy, they just challenged it openly.
The leader of the Broken Blade Sect is very old, and he was very unwilling after losing to Bai Yu, so he came to help the enemy after giving up the position of leader.
Bai Yu went looking for immortals, and finally set his sights on the old man.
The two were equally powerful and fought endlessly.
This beating lasted for several years, and he suffered many internal injuries.
In the last duel, both of them practiced a unique move. In the end, the master was slightly better, and then he accidentally killed the old leader of the Broken Blade Sect.
In fact, the two have become friends for such a long time. Now that he accidentally killed his friend, the master was immediately ashamed.
They just want to decide the outcome, not kill each other.
It's better now. Master was originally injured, and due to his mood, he passed away within a few years.
Standing in front of the grave, Bai Yu felt an indescribable feeling in his heart.
It was the first time in this life that I experienced separation from life and death.
He knew that this was just the beginning and there would be more in the future.
"Two old guys, trying to imitate young people in playing one-on-one games..."
Bai Yu stood in front of the grave and muttered.
The junior sister went back and brought paper money and incense candles.
"Alas~."
With a sigh, Bai Yu knelt down and began to worship the old man.
He was kind to Bai Yu, kind to him in nurturing and educating.
It is appropriate to kneel to him.
After the worship, Bai Yu went back with his junior sister.
The junior sister was very happy when the senior brother returned, so she cooked a large table of dishes.
During the meal, Shuang'er kept staring at Bai Yu.
Looking at each other, she pretended not to look, and then peeked again.
Children are curious, but Bai Yu didn't expose her even with a slight smile.
After dinner, it was getting dark, and Bai Yu and his junior sister were sitting in the pavilion in the courtyard chatting.
The main thing is that she asks and he answers.
I learned that Bai Yu had been struggling for twenty years with no results.
She was not comforted, but she was very happy.
While eating the orange, she asked expectantly: "Senior brother, you won't leave from now on, right?
Didn't you say before that you wanted to give the sect a good name? How about this? Let's recruit more disciples and simply expand the size of the sect and make it bigger and stronger. "
Hearing this, Bai Yu was a little stunned. These words were all those he had said before.
"Be bigger and stronger."
Repeated in a low voice, Bai Yu's eyes were confused.
title_en: Chapter 7 The direction of the road Chapter 8 Determining the direction
